blocks.text: `match` can also produce a value: you tie each branch to a single expression with `=>` and assign the result to a variable or `return` it.

blocks.prompt: Write `days_in(month: i32) -> i32` (28 for February): 2 => 28; 4, 6, 9, 11 => 30; others => 31. Print month 9.
blocks.hint: Write three branches after `return match month:`.

blocks.q: In an expression `match`, how must the value of every branch be?
options: It may be of any type
It must be the same type
blocks.why: The result goes into a single variable, so the types must match.
